title: install.json
description: The install record at .rbtv/config/install.json: what rbtv installed in one target folder. Maintained by rbtv; authors may edit selections and apply them through the documented refresh.

schema.description: The version of this record's format.

marker.description: The per-unit generated-file ownership marker, `rbtv-managed`. Shared files use booked keys or fenced sections; guidance copies use a generated banner. The install record tracks installed units and files.

files.description: The files chosen on their own, as full <module>/<component>#<name> ids. This is the root selection; component records separately report what was generated.

packs.description: The names of packs enabled for this root installation.

guidance_basis.description: The folder instructions file the author writes: CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md.

guidance_excludes.description: Paths rbtv does not walk when it writes folder instructions copies.

components.description: Each installed component, keyed by its id.

tree.description: Where the component came from: `repo` for a component shipped in the rbtv repository, or `mirror` for a local component.

harnesses.description: The harnesses this component was installed for.

selected.description: Each installed skill, rule, command, agent, hook, MCP server, tool, or folder-instructions file of the component, keyed by its name.

method.description: How it is installed: its exposure method, `tool` for a tool placed on PATH, or `folder-instructions` for a component's marked section.

files.description: The files rbtv wrote for it.

claims.description: Keys or fenced sections it owns inside files shared with other components, such as a hook's entry in a harness settings file or a rule's section in root AGENTS.md.

links.description: Commands rbtv placed on PATH for it.

sub_agent.description: Only on a unit of method `agent` installed as a harness-native sub-agent: the model and effort its file is written with, keyed by harness. A harness with no entry has no sub-agent file. Absent when no harness has values.

model.description: The model, by the name `cast models list` shows.

model_id.description: The same model, by the harness's own name for it, as written into the sub-agent file.

effort.description: The effort, as a word: a number from 1 to 5 is recorded as the model's own word for it.

model.description: The model, by the name `cast models list` shows.

model_id.description: The same model, by the harness's own name for it, as written into the sub-agent file.

effort.description: The effort, as a word: a number from 1 to 5 is recorded as the model's own word for it.

model.description: The model, by the name `cast models list` shows.

model_id.description: The same model, by the harness's own name for it, as written into the sub-agent file.

effort.description: The effort, as a word: a number from 1 to 5 is recorded as the model's own word for it.

shared_files.description: Files shared by components through booked keys or fenced sections.

shared_claims.description: Which component owns each booked key or fenced section inside a shared file, as path::key.

path_links.description: Links rbtv placed on PATH for tools.
